Exam Description: MR BRAIN WITH AND WITHOUT CONTRAST
Report Text:
INDICATION:
 MR BRAIN WITH AND WITHOUT CONTRAST   11/14/2023 10:15 AM
CLINICAL HISTORY: Diagnosed xanthoastrocytoma with surgical resection in January 2023. Complaints of episodic headaches.
COMPARISON: Brain MRI August 12, 2023.
TECHNIQUE: Multiple sequences through the brain were acquired at 3.0 tesla.
CONTRAST MEDIA: Intravenous gadolinium-based contrast was administered.
FINDINGS:
There are postsurgical changes from resection in the left frontal lobe with evidence of craniotomy. Mild linear enhancement near the resection cavity, consistent with postoperative changes, without evidence of nodular enhancement to suggest recurrence.
Scattered punctate areas of susceptibility artifact likely representing post-surgical changes and possible microhemorrhages.
No acute infarct, significant mass effect, or midline shift is evident. Ventricular system and basal cisterns are within normal limits.
No abnormal parenchymal enhancement or new T2 hyperintensities.

IMPRESSION:
1. No radiological evidence of recurrent xanthoastrocytoma.
2. Postoperative changes in the left frontal region. 
3. Benign post-surgical artifacts noted. 
END OF IMPRESSION
